text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Saudi Arabia's second largest electricity company is cosidering a build, operate and transfer scheme for a $2 billion power plant, part of plans to involve the private sector in state-run utilities.
- Saudi Arabia studies measures to boost its industry to diversify income and increase private sector participation.
- Bahrain projects 1997-98 two-year budget at 1.3 billion dinars, forecasts a lower deficit and higher oil revenue.
